CNC machining and CNC turning in Ipoh

Weng Loi Machinery runs CNC lathes and a CNC machining centre alongside our manual shop, so we can make accurate, repeatable parts, one-off or in batches. Send a drawing, a sample or a worn part, and our engineers will quote it.

What we make

  • Shafts, splined shafts and pins
  • Bushings and sleeves
  • Flanges and couplings
  • Gears and gear blanks
  • Threaded fittings, plugs and adapters
  • Nozzles and other non-ferrous parts
  • Replacement parts copied from a worn original
  • Prototypes from a drawing or sketch

Materials

We machine steels, non-ferrous metals such as brass and copper, plastics and composites. Tell us the material on your drawing, or send the original part and we will advise.

How it works

  1. Send your drawing or part. WhatsApp a drawing, photo or sample to Lily, with the quantity you need.
  2. Get a quote. We confirm the material, tolerances and quantity, and quote.
  3. Collect your parts. Machined and checked before they leave the workshop.

Recent work

Frequently asked questions

Do you take one-off jobs or only batch production?

Both. We make single replacement parts and prototypes as well as batch production runs.

What is the largest part you can CNC machine?

Our CNC lathes turn up to ø440 mm diameter and 820 mm length. The CNC machining centre has a 1,000 × 500 mm table and takes up to 700 kg. Longer parts are turned on our long-bed lathes (shafts up to 4 m long and ø300 mm), and flanges and plates up to ø1,600 mm are faced on our face lathe.

Can you work from a sample if I have no drawing?

Yes. We can measure your sample or worn part and machine a copy, or reverse-engineer it with you.

What tolerances can you hold?

It depends on the part, the size and the material. Mark the tolerances you need on your drawing or tell us when you send the photo, and we will confirm what we can hold before we quote.

What materials do you machine?

Steels, non-ferrous metals such as brass and copper, plastics and composites.
